dashboards.note: London, 2006. You haven’t slept in weeks, and now you’ve slipped through the cracks into the Mad City. Madness has given you strange powers, but here, Nightmares hunt people like you.
dashboards.shelfDesc: Insomniacs lost in the Mad City. Exhaustion, Madness, Pain and the clock, all on one shared screen.

dashboards.note: Demons hunt Atarashi High, where schoolgirls with PSI abilities must fight side by side with their friends and rivals, hiding their powers to avoid becoming outcasts.
dashboards.shelfDesc: Neon idols and psychic weirdness. Moves, clocks and countdowns, all on one screen.
